text:
"$vgc_reyes_title." Reyes doesn't look up from her slate. "One of our convoys went dark near the Kestrel belt eleven days ago. Three freighters, forty crew."

"Find them, and the Compact pays 60,000 credits."
"Pirates, probably. The belt is where they hide."
The convoy's hulks drift among the rocks, cold and silent.

script:

text: Your salvage crews board the lead freighter. In the bridge wreckage they find what you came for.
Reyes turns the black box over in her hands. "So they didn't make it. But now their families will know why."

text: Reyes nods once. "The convoy's last position is in your nav computer. Start with the Kestrel belt, and watch for raiders."
As you dock, a message from Commodore Reyes is waiting: she wants to see you at once.

id: # sagaforge:begin quest=vgc_salvage_rights hash=68837b81 (generated by Saga Forge; edits here are overwritten)

text: Reyes wants the convoy's cargo recovered before the scavengers get it.

script:
$missionId = vgc_salvage_rights
ShowPersonVisual false vgc_reyes
SetShortcut vgc_salvage_rights_decline "ESCAPE"
text: "The convoy's cargo is still out there, $vgc_reyes_title. I'd rather we had it than the scavengers."
You transmit the salvage rights Reyes granted you. The Compact warning beacons on the hulks fall silent.
The convoy's holds are yours to work now, and whatever your crews can recover.
